Telangana CM Discusses Hyderabad Metro Loan with Union Minister

Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy met with Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw in Delhi to discuss a loan from IRFC for the Hyderabad Metro's takeover. Both sides described the talks as positive. The meeting focused on the financial aspects of the metro project.
